basic_info.description: 1700-1704 Filbert St offers a rare opportunity to acquire a well-maintained, mixed-use asset in the heart of San Francisco's highly desirable Cow Hollow neighborhood. This 9-unit building features an ideal blend of residential and commercial income, with two ground-floor retail spaces leased to stable tenants and seven thoughtfully designed apartment units above - comprising two spacious 2-bedroom units and five comfortable 1-bedroom units.     The residential units boast efficient layouts and enjoy abundant natural light, both highly livable and attractive to tenants. Located on a prime stretch of Filbert Street, the property is immersed in the charm and vibrancy of Cow Hollow. Just steps from the shops, cafes, and restaurants of Union and Chestnut Streets, the neighborhood's walkability and lifestyle amenities support consistently strong tenant demand and occupancy.    Whether you're seeking stable cash flow with future upside or looking to establish a presence in one of San Francisco's premier neighborhoods, 1700-1704 Filbert St presents a compelling investment opportunity in a highly sought-after location. In-place cap rate of 5.11% and 11.83 GRM.
